correctness.rationale: For n>=3 uniform independently oriented tournament and directed r-cycle count C_{r,n} modulo cyclic rotation, conditioning on occurrence of any directed r-cycle fixes exactly one incoming and one outgoing incident edge at each of its r vertices. Its score law becomes 1+Bin(n-3,1/2), while all other vertices retain Bin(n-1,1/2). Summing over cycles yields covariance (n)_r/2^r times [Q_{n,k}-B_{n,k}], with Q/B=4k(n-1-k)/((n-1)(n-2)), exactly the asserted square-root sign polynomial [n-1-(2k-(n-1))^2]. Integer zeros iff n-1=s², s>=2, at k=(s²±s)/2. The ratio to the triangle covariance is a_{r,n}=(n-3)_(r-3)/2^(r-3). The deterministic identity T=binom(n,3)-sum_k binom(k,2)N_k proves centered T in the linear score-span, hence residual orthogonality to every N_k identifies the exact L² *linear projection*; it is not full conditional expectation. Independently enumerated all labeled tournaments for n=3..5 (2^3+2^6+2^10=1096 orientations) and checked 26 exact rational covariance pairs; all matched. General proof follows from conditioning, not finite cases.
